metadata.name: shortwin
metadata.description: short.win: permissionless P2P token lending for shorting memecoins (Anchor program)

instructions.name: add_margin
docs: The borrower adds SOL margin to its position (it only raises CR).

accounts.name: market
docs: Read only (C0-17); bound to its PDA with the stored bump.

instructions.name: apply_config
docs: Anyone applies the pending change once its timelock has run.

accounts.name: fee_recipient
docs: `check_fee_recipient` (System-owned, not executable); `mut` proves the runtime lets it
be written. Never read or written otherwise.

accounts.name: oracle_cache
docs: `OracleFeed` only: emptied (the bump stays).

instructions.name: cancel_config
docs: Governance or the Emergency vault cancels the pending change.

accounts.name: authority
docs: `governance` or `pause_authority`.

instructions.name: claim_sol
docs: A lender claims its realised SOL.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The lender; receives the SOL, and the `LenderPosition` rent when the claim closes it

accounts.name: market
docs: Read-only (C0-17). Bound to its PDA `["market", mint]` with the stored bump
(`Market::is_pda`; ARCH §2.3; M1-SEC-6 / M1-FID-6).

instructions.name: close_short
docs: The borrower buys back and closes its position.

accounts.name: borrower
docs: The position's borrower; receives the position's remainder and rent (A18).

accounts.name: position
docs: Bound to its PDA `["position", market, borrower, nonce]` with the stored bump.

instructions.name: cover_deficit
docs: A lender covers a negative SOL balance.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The lender; pays the lamports.

accounts.name: market
docs: Read-only (C0-17). Bound to its PDA `["market", mint]` with the stored bump
(`Market::is_pda`; ARCH §2.3; M1-SEC-6 / M1-FID-6).

instructions.name: crank_price
docs: Anyone runs a market's prologue (observation, chains) and refreshes its tier.

accounts.name: mint
docs: in the handler); PumpSwap's fee tier reads its supply (M6).

instructions.name: crank_sol_usd
docs: Anyone refreshes the cached SOL/USD price.

accounts.name: price_update
docs: The configured Pyth `PriceUpdateV2` (address `config.pyth_sol_usd`, owner the receiver).

instructions.name: create_market
docs: Anyone lists a mint, paying at most `max_creation_fee`.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Pays for every account and the creation fee. Confers nothing: `Market.creator` is
informational.

accounts.name: venue_guard
docs: The venue-upgrade latch (A7; M3-SEC-2): a Raydium listing is refused while a bit of the
Raydium mask is set (`VenueUpgraded`), as opens are. Read only.

accounts.name: market
docs: One market per mint, whatever its token program.

accounts.name: pool_vault
docs: The PDA-addressed pool vault: a token account of `mint` owned by `token_program`,
authority = the market PDA. Not an ATA: a pre-created ATA would block the listing
forever (R-MINT §8.2).

accounts.name: mint
docs: The listed mint: owned by SPL Token or Token-2022 (and by `token_program`), not a
native mint, well-formed, no freeze authority, allowlisted extensions only.

accounts.name: trader
docs: The market's `trader` PDA (`["trader", market]`): system-owned, zero data, never
allocated (ARCH §2.4).

accounts.name: trader_base_ata
docs: `ATA(trader, mint, token_program)`: created with `create_idempotent` and then
validated on the pump venues (M5).

instructions.name: deposit
docs: A lender deposits tokens.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The lender; pays for its `LenderPosition` on first deposit.

accounts.name: owner_token_account
docs: The lender's source token account (its authority is checked by the token program).

instructions.name: disable_venue
docs: The Emergency vault disables a venue for opens.

instructions.name: execute_pool_switch
docs: Anyone resolves a collection window once it has run: adopts the best candidate if it is
still eligible (with its locked SOL at the SOL floor), its program is not latched and,
on a Raydium market, the `pool_fail` chain that armed the window still holds; else
cancels.

accounts.name: venue_guard
docs: The venue-upgrade latch: a window whose candidate's program bit is set is cancelled, not
adopted (module docs step 5; M4-SEC-8, M4V-4). Read only.

accounts.name: mint
docs: the handler).

accounts.name: oracle_cache
docs: The cached SOL/USD price: the tier the market would have on the window's candidate, whose
opening caps its open positions must fit ("switch only if all fit"; module docs step 4).
Read only.

instructions.name: expire
docs: A keeper exits an expired, not CR-liquidatable position (ARCH §3.7).

accounts.name: keeper
docs: The keeper (anyone).

instructions.name: flag_unsafe_mint
docs: Anyone flags a market whose mint fails the safety filter.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The market's mint, parsed by the filter.

instructions.name: flag_venue_upgraded
docs: Anyone records a venue program upgrade in the latch.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: upgradeable loader; its header is read (`shortwin_venue_state`), and its ELF when the
account grew since a fingerprinted revalidation (AIR-01).

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Creates `GlobalConfig`, `VenueGuard`, the `VenueExtras` and `OracleCache` (upgrade
authority, once).

accounts.name: authority
docs: short.win's upgrade authority (checked against `program_data`); pays for the accounts.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: short.win's own ProgramData (`PDA(BPFLoaderUpgradeable, [program id])`); its upgrade
authority must be the signer.

instructions.name: liquidate
docs: A keeper liquidates a CR-liquidatable position within the fixed exit bound (ARCH §3.6).

accounts.name: keeper
docs: The keeper (anyone).

instructions.name: open_short
docs: A borrower opens a short of `q` tokens (borrow, sell, lock proceeds and D4 margin).

accounts.name: borrower
docs: The borrower: pays for the position, the exposure record, the margin and the open fee.

accounts.name: venue_guard
docs: The venue-upgrade latch (A7): read only by opens.

accounts.name: oracle_cache
docs: The cached SOL/USD price for the tier (ARCH §4.7).

accounts.name: trader
docs: normalisation.

instructions.name: propose_config
docs: Governance proposes a timelocked config change.

instructions.name: propose_pool
docs: Anyone proposes a Raydium pool of kind `candidate_kind` (4 AMM v4, 5 CPMM) for a
list-only or Raydium market: an immediate adoption (a list-only market without open
positions; no open position with the listing-window or zero-position margin) or a
collection window (the fast path; a list-only market with open positions).

accounts.name: venue_guard
docs: The venue-upgrade latch (A7; module docs step 3): a proposal is refused while the bit of
the candidate's program is set (`VenueUpgraded`, M4-SEC-8). Read only.

accounts.name: mint
docs: the handler); the candidate's token side must be this mint under that program.

accounts.name: oracle_cache
docs: The cached SOL/USD price: the tier the market would have on a window candidate, whose
opening caps its open positions must fit ("switch only if all fit"; module docs step 6).
Read only.

instructions.name: revalidate_venue
docs: The Emergency vault re-validates an upgraded venue program at `expected_slot`, naming
the sha256 of the trimmed ELF it reviewed (AIR-01; all zero: the slot alone).

accounts.name: program_data
docs: upgradeable loader; its header is read, and its ELF when the slot moved (AIR-01).

instructions.name: set_coverage_pause
docs: The keeper's `coverage_authority` pauses or resumes new opens on one market for lost
keeper coverage (degraded mode; O17); the Emergency vault may resume them too (clear
only; OWNER-M7-3). Opens only; moves nothing.

accounts.name: coverage_authority
docs: `config.coverage_authority` (the keeper's pause-opens-only key; O17: sets or clears), or
`config.pause_authority` (the Emergency vault; OWNER-M7-3 (b): clears only).

accounts.name: market
docs: The market, bound to its PDA `["market", mint]` with the stored bump (`Market::is_pda`;
M1-SEC-6).

instructions.name: set_pause
docs: Pauses or resumes new opens, globally or on one market.

accounts.name: authority
docs: `pause_authority` or `governance`.

accounts.name: market
docs: The market, for `PauseScope::Market` only; bound to its PDA `["market", mint]` with the
stored bump (`Market::is_pda`; ARCH §2.3; M1-SEC-6).

instructions.name: set_route_broken
docs: The Emergency vault flags or clears a broken route (opens and S3 evidence only).

accounts.name: authority
docs: `pause_authority` or `governance`.

accounts.name: market
docs: The market, for `PauseScope::Market` only; bound to its PDA `["market", mint]` with
the stored bump (`Market::is_pda`).

instructions.name: set_venue_extras
docs: The Emergency vault publishes a venue's bounded trailing accounts.

accounts.name: authority
docs: `pause_authority` or `governance`.

instructions.name: sol_settle
docs: A keeper settles a position in SOL on the settlement box (S1/S2/S3; ARCH §3.8).

accounts.name: keeper
docs: The keeper (anyone); pays for a new `ShareEpoch` record.

accounts.name: share_epoch_rec
docs: market.share_epoch])`; created with the grief-proof helper only when the epoch rolls.

instructions.name: sweep_protocol_fees
docs: Anyone moves a market's protocol fees to the configured recipient.

accounts.name: market
docs: Bound to its PDA `["market", mint]` with the stored bump
(`Market::is_pda`; ARCH §2.3; M1-SEC-6).

instructions.name: sweep_trader
docs: Anyone sweeps SOL left on a market's trader side to lenders; after a full wipe it
credits the wipe record and sets `wipe_trader_swept` (ARCH §3.9; M2-SEC-4).

accounts.name: market
docs: Bound to its PDA `["market", mint]` with the stored bump (`Market::is_pda`; no mint is
passed).

accounts.name: trader
docs: normalisation).

accounts.name: trader_wsol
docs: instructions (checked by the normalisation).

instructions.name: sync_lender
docs: Anyone advances a lender through share epochs; through a rebase record only its owner,
anyone else's sync stopping there with the pot-only touch (KI-66).

accounts.name: market
docs: Read-only (C0-17). Bound to its PDA `["market", mint]` with the stored bump
(`Market::is_pda`; ARCH §2.3; M1-SEC-6 / M1-FID-6).

accounts.name: owner
docs: The position's owner. Signing, it converts the lender through rebase records
(KI65-REV-SEC1); unsigned, anyone may send the instruction, which then stops at a rebase
record with the pot-only touch (KI-66).

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: A lender withdraws its pro-rata part (tokens and SOL), bounded below by `min_tokens`
and `min_sol`.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The lender; receives the SOL part and the `LenderPosition` rent when it closes.

accounts.name: owner_token_account
docs: The destination token account (any account of this mint the owner chooses).

accounts.name: memo_program
docs: memos. spl-memo v3/v4.
The memo program, for a Token-2022 destination with `MemoTransfer` only (else pass the
program id, Anchor's "none").

types.name: ExtraEntry
docs: One trailing account (176 B).

fields.name: kind
docs: `ENTRY_NONE`, `ENTRY_FIXED` or `ENTRY_TEMPLATE`.

fields.name: writable
docs: 1 if the account is passed writable.

fields.name: n_seeds
docs: Seed parts used (template).

fields.name: key
docs: The fixed key, or the template's program.

types.name: ExtraEntryArg
docs: One trailing account, as the argument encoding of [`ExtraEntry`]: `kind` 1 = a fixed `key`,
2 = a template derived under program `key` from `seeds`.

types.name: ExtrasSel
docs: The extras set a trading instruction selects (ARCH §3.0 "Bounded extras", A41): `set`
([`EXTRAS_SET_NONE`], [`EXTRAS_SET_CURRENT`], [`EXTRAS_SET_PREVIOUS`],
[`EXTRAS_SET_STABLE`]) and, for each
template entry `i`, the canonical bump `bumps[i]` of the account it derives (fixed entries
ignore theirs; a non-canonical bump is `BadExtras`, M2-SEC-3).

types.name: ExtrasSet
docs: A set of up to 4 entries with its version (712 B).

fields.name: count
docs: Entries used.

types.name: GlobalConfig
docs: The global configuration (ARCH §2.3.2).

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version ([`crate::constants::CONFIG_VERSION`]).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump of `["config"]`.

fields.name: flags
docs: Bit 0 [`CONFIG_FLAG_PAUSED_OPENS`].

fields.name: venue_enabled
docs: Venues enabled for opens (`VENUE_BIT_*`). Enabling is timelocked (`EnableVenues`),
disabling immediate (`disable_venue`); affects opens only.

fields.name: venue_route_broken
docs: Route-broken venues (same bits; Emergency, O6 — built in M2). Opens and S3 evidence
only (A40).

fields.name: timelock_s
docs: Governance timelock, seconds (`MIN_TIMELOCK_S ≤ timelock_s ≤ MAX_TIMELOCK_S`).

fields.name: params_version
docs: Incremented by every applied `Params` change.

fields.name: governance
docs: Squads Governance vault (48 h Squads time lock).

fields.name: pause_authority
docs: Squads Emergency vault (time lock 0).

fields.name: coverage_authority

fields.name: max_q_hwm
docs: High-water mark of `q` over the positions opened since `open_positions` last returned to 0
(was `_reserved[0..8]`; owner decision of 2026-09-29, "switch only if all fit"): raised by
every open (`engine::waterfall::add_position`), reset to 0 by the exit that takes
`open_positions` to 0 (`remove_position`), so it is at least every open position's `q` —
conservative by design (a position that has closed may have set it). A pool adoption that
carries open positions checks `min(max_q_hwm, ΣB_Q)` against the candidate's per-position
caps in O(1) (`shortwin_math::caps::carried_fit`; `engine::pool_select::carried_fit`).

fields.name: min_open_fee_ppm
docs: Low-water mark of the one-way venue fee φ (ppm) the opens since `open_positions` last
returned to 0 paid — the fee their caps were computed at and their margin posted at (was
`_reserved[8..12]`; FIT-2): set by the first open after the market emptied, lowered by every
later one (`engine::waterfall::add_position`, `shortwin_math::caps::open_fee_mark`), reset
to 0 with `max_q_hwm` (`remove_position`). The carried fit's fee-scaled caps take
`min(min_open_fee_ppm, φ_cand, CARRIED_FEE_CAP_PPM)` (`shortwin_math::caps::carried_phi`;
`engine::pool_select::carried_caps`; FITS-1: 25 bps), so a position carried onto a
higher-fee pool stays in the size class of the fee it was margined at, and none above the
25-bps class.

fields.name: trader_wsol_ata
docs: `ATA(trader, WSOL)` under SPL Token (the pump curve's TradeExtras T11, `sweep_trader`'s
stray-ATA slot): derived once at listing instead of on every trade. The trader is the
market's PDA, so a coin's creator who grinds the mint can give this ATA a low bump, and
`find_program_address` charges 1,500 CU per bump it tries (M5-SEC-6).

fields.name: pump_pool_authority
docs: `PDA(pump, ["pool-authority", mint])`, the canonical PumpSwap pool's `creator`, which
`canonical_pool_valid` compares (ARCH §2.5); derived once at listing for the same reason.

fields.name: coverage_cleared_at
docs: M7-SEC-3 (was `_reserved[0..8]`): the unix second `set_coverage_pause(false)` last cleared
a set `paused_coverage` flag (signed by the coverage key or, since OWNER-M7-3, the Emergency
vault). `open_short` refuses until `COVERAGE_CLEAR_DELAY_S` after it
(`CoveragePaused`; `engine::guard::open_static`), so the `coverage_authority` key cannot
bracket an open on a coverage-paused market — `[clear, open_short, set]` in one
transaction or one second — and the flag stays visibly cleared for the keeper's reads
before any open can land. 0 on existing accounts (no delay).

fields.name: lender_credit_rem
docs: AIR-03 (was `_reserved[0..16]`): the remainder of the last accrual's lender rent credit,
`(Σ_j A_j·δJ_j + rem) mod (10⁴·10⁴·31,536,000·WAD)` (`shortwin_math::rent::
lender_credit_carried`, `engine::prologue::accrue`), carried into the next accrual so the
credits sum to the floor of their exact total instead of flooring each accrual alone (a
market cranked every second lost up to a lamport a second, which the exits' true-ups
left in `lender_sol`). Always below that denominator; 0 on existing accounts.

fields.name: min_open_hard_cap_bps
docs: AIR-19 (was `_reserved[16..18]`): low-water mark of the `venue_fee_hard_cap_bps` the
positions opened since `open_positions` last returned to 0 locked — set by the first open
after the market emptied, lowered by every later one (`engine::waterfall::add_position`),
reset to 0 by the exit that takes `open_positions` to 0 (`remove_position`), so it is at
most every open position's locked cap (conservative by design: a position that has
closed may have set it). The market's S3 chain counts a live fee above
`min(global cap, this mark)` as no route (`engine::route::s3_no_route`), so a position
whose locked cap is below a raised global cap reaches S3 when the fee passes its own cap.
0 (unset) on existing accounts: the global cap alone, as before.
